title: ToyOS smoke probes must frontload fs stress and user probe
symptom: qemu_user_probe_assertions or qemu_filesystem_stress_assertions intermittently miss their completion markers within the 20s smoke window.
root_cause: Same-priority startup ordering caused user-probe and fs-stress to be scheduled too late behind noisier kernel jobs.
fix: Create fs-stress before kernel-maint and other heavier kernel jobs.
Create user-probe immediately after fs-stress so both probes get early scheduler turns.
Keep shell and mixed probes later in the startup list.
